item.title: ExpressVPN: Privacy Audit | Technical Integrity 2026
item.description: ### 1. Cryptographic Latency & Server Grid Check We subjected ExpressVPN to a battery of technical stress tests from multiple European exit nodes. The 2026 node clusters registered average connection overheads of less than 3.8ms, representing elite performance for secure packet routing. - Prot...
